title: citrus × aurantium subf. hakunikuyu
intro: Citrus × aurantium subf. hakunikuyu, commonly known as Hakonic acid citrus, is a rare and lesser-known citrus species that is primarily cultivated in Japan. This plant is known for its unique and potent bioactive properties, which have been traditionally used to support various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as potential antimicrobial and anti-cancer activities. The therapeutic actions of Hakonic acid citrus are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, making it a sought-after ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
